blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY— About 200 foreign nationals were found during an interagency operation targeting a suspected scam hub in Zamboanga Sibugay, where authorities also recovered an estimated 2,000 mobile phones, computers, laptops and other electronic equipment, the Philippine Army said on Friday.
